items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: Little Roy Evans. Roy Evans. Do you know him too?

ctx.x: When Ricard died, Ricard Alexis died, his wife died. I went to his way. And Grace Edwards, she used to play piano with me too. And he said, you know who's out there? Alfred Williams. I said Alfred Williams. He said, yeah, don't you know the left hand drummer? He used to play with Sam Morgan. I said, oh yeah. I said, let me see if he knew he knew me. I said, Alfred, come here. He said, you know this man? He said, no. He said, you know see me before, man. He said, no. I don't remember. I said, where you belong…
And I saw Stan had another good drummer one time. I mean Sam Morgan. Roy. Oh yeah, Roy. Little Roy Evans. Roy Evans. Do you know him too?
